library/: poses and clips from the MakeHuman community pose packs (CC0)
rig/default_rig.json: default body rig of the Anny model (NAVER LABS Europe, Apache-2.0; rig and mesh from MakeHuman MPFB2, CC0)
rig/limits.json: derived from the CC0 MakeHuman community pose packs
rig/mannequin.glb: default body of the Anny model (Apache-2.0; mesh from MakeHuman MPFB2, CC0)
rig/ranges.json: joint range-of-motion tables: clinical limits from CDC (Soucie et al. 2011), Roaas & Andersson 1982, Baumbach et al. 2014 and WA DSHS 13-585A; mocap band from CMU, 100STYLE (CC BY 4.0), ACCAD (CC BY 3.0) and AddBiomechanics (CC BY 4.0)
